newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai stock exchange chairman dies, aged 69.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai stock exchange chairman dies, aged 69.

text.p: The chairman of the board of directors of the Shanghai Stock Exchange, Li Xiangrui, died in late January of an unspecified illness, the Liberation Daily said on Sunday.
Li, 69, died in Shanghai, the newspaper said but gave no further details.
Li had been the chairman of the Shanghai bourse since it was established in December 1990 and had "made great contributions" to the development of modern China's stock markets, it said.
Li had worked in China's finance sector for more than 40 years, it said. He was governor of the Shanghai-based Communications Bank from 1987 to 1990, and the bank's chairman from 1990 to 1993.
